issue_gist: MathUtils.gcd(Integer.MIN_VALUE, 0) returns Integer.MIN_VALUE (a negative number) instead of throwing an ArithmeticException, since the true result 2^31 can't be represented as a nonnegative int. This is inconsistent with gcd(Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MIN_VALUE), which already throws.
